answer: Anchor each identity to one public artifact it authored — a dataset, tool, or essay with a real history of use by strangers. Each epoch a gale of peer reviewers samples artifacts at random and demands a live edit or explanation only the true author can give within minutes. Only artifacts strangers actually use climb toward the summit of trust. A farm must fabricate a hundred genuinely useful artifacts with a hundred real user bases; copying one artifact across clones fails at once, because the artifact is the anchor and it can belong to only one identity.
